About the release

2025 Topps Chrome Football Sapphire Edition brings a premium edge to one of the hobby’s most recognizable chromium brands, combining the return of licensed Topps NFL Chrome with Sapphire’s signature crystal-style finish. Building off the excitement around 2025 Topps Chrome Football’s return to the NFL space, Sapphire is expected to feature exclusive parallels, limited production, and a strong lineup of NFL stars, legends, and top rookies.

Collectors can expect a mix of rookie content, low-numbered color, and premium autograph chases featuring the 2025 rookie class alongside established veterans and all-time greats. Popular Chrome inserts and autograph concepts are also expected to return with exclusive Sapphire treatments that have made the brand one of the most sought-after Chrome releases across the hobby.

With Topps Chrome Football reestablishing itself as one of the hobby’s top NFL releases, Sapphire delivers a more premium collector experience — combining clean designs, limited color, and strong rookie potential for collectors chasing the NFL’s next generation of stars.

About the release

The 2025 Topps Chrome® Formula 1® Sapphire Edition collection has arrived, featuring the largest Rookie lineup ever seen in a Topps F1® release.
Collect the full 200-card Base Sapphire Set showcasing F1®, F2™ and F3™ drivers, F1® cars, F1® duos, team logo cards, and including more legends than any other collection! 
This edition shines with Sapphire-only parallels and features two exclusive insert sets, Infinite Sapphire and Sapphire Selections, delivering refined design, depth, and brilliance that set Sapphire apart as the peak of Chrome collecting.
This year’s release also brings Sapphire Edition inserts such as Helmet Collection, Speed Demons, Floor It, 1975 Speed Wheels and Ace of Trades.
Keep an eye out for Sapphire Autograph Cards from your favourite drivers.
Push to the finish line and complete the set!

About the brand

Since its debut in 2020, F1® Topps Chrome® Sapphire Edition has become a modern classic in the Hobby, bringing its trademark shine and innovation to the pinnacle of motorsport. 
Combining cutting-edge design with the adrenaline of racing, F1® Topps Chrome® Sapphire Edition captures the speed, style, and stars of the grid combined with the iconic Sapphire finish. 
With its striking parallels, beautiful Autographs and rare chases it continues to set the standard for F1® trading cards.
